name: Zeitreisender Schonmorgen
personality: Has arrived just in time to miss the reason for coming.
visual_intent: Time Wrinkle Traveller: tall crooked comma ink blob,small patched plum travel cap,tiny cream scarf,ONE brass pocket clock with visibly bent soft face and short folded map. One huge eye one narrowed eye,small toothless off-centre open oval mouth,looking backward over own shoulder
biography: Has arrived just in time to miss the reason for coming. His bent HyperNorm clock keeps appointments with events that have already changed their minds. A dissonant card asks whether arriving late can also mean leaving early. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. note: FrizzleBob: Die Ankunft liegt knapp hinter ihrem Anlass.
